cause: THE FOUR CONTENT-COHERENCE DEFECTS SEEN LIVE ON 2026-09-18, fixed at the owner's order ("impliment every fix"). ONE CAUSE: every movement below is authored CONTENT the engine showed a reader, and no tuning constant, no threshold and no rng draw is touched anywhere in it. THE CONTROLS FIRST, because the figures are worthless without them. BASE-SIDE TOTALITY: the base fe021a487, regenerated from committed bytes in its own extracted tree, reproduces tests/fixtures/generator-golden-master.json on ALL 525 ROWS - 0 mismatches, key set identical - so this lane is the only source of the drift. ATTRIBUTION: three single-variable trees were built (base plus one defect each) and censused whole-settlement against the base, array indices collapsed to path templates. D1 ALONE MOVES 130 OF 525 (thorp 12, hamlet 84, village 12, metropolis 22) over TEN path templates and nothing else, every substitution a cured string: $.npcs[].role and $.factions[].members[].role 118 changes each and $.relationships[].npc1Role 164 / npc2Role 82, all ONE substitution, "Parish Priest" -> "Priest"; $.availableServices.healing[].name 96 changes, ONE substitution, "Sunday mass" -> "Weekly rite"; $.availableServices.healing[].desc 157 over three (the weekly-service, graveyard and marriage descriptions); and the priest's two goal strings 106 and 12, on the NPC and on the faction-member copy alike. ZERO structural movement - no roster, no faction, no array-length move, no draw. The service menu's KEY ORDER is preserved so the service roll is character-for-character unmoved, and both new names are REGISTERED in SERVICE_CATEGORY_MAP at the 'healing' category they already carried, so no service changes bucket (the walker's heuristic quarantine shrinks 651 -> 649, a banked win). The INSTITUTION name could not follow and is reported rather than forced: institutionalCatalog.slugifyInstitutionName makes the canonical name the catalog id, there is no display field separate from it, and the chair's rule was never ids. THE RENAME CARRIED ONE DEBT THAT NO GOLDEN COULD SEE, AND IT IS RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN LEFT TO BE REDISCOVERED: factionRoles.ROLE_KEY_SYNONYMS held `parishpriest: 'temple'` and no `priest`, so on the FALLBACK path - the one taken when an NPC's factionAffiliation does not resolve to a power seat, which is where custom, imported and partial records arrive - a realized Priest stopped covering the temple office and ensureFactionStructuralNpcs appended a second seat beside him (probed: 'Parish Priest' -> npcs 1, 'Priest' -> npcs 2). `priest: 'temple'` is added and the old key kept, because a settlement saved before the rename carries the old string forever. It moves ZERO rows of this corpus and the figures above and below are unchanged, because the generated pipeline reaches that office through ROLE_FACTION_MAP and the power seat and never takes the fallback - which is exactly why a dead synonym is invisible to every instrument that walks only the happy path, and why the structural claim this record makes for D2 is stated on the PIPELINE path, where it was measured. D1b, THE SAME CURE AT VILLAGE AND ABOVE, MOVES 441 FURTHER ROWS, over SEVEN path templates and nothing else, every substitution a cured string: 638 changes over 7 distinct in $.availableServices.healing[].desc, 83 in $.availableServices.information[].desc, 84 in $.powerStructure.factions[].desc (the priest sentence), and the three renamed role labels across $.npcs[].role 108, $.factions[].members[].role 108, $.relationships[].npc1Role 144 and npc2Role 276. Twenty-two service names and descriptions lose diocese, High mass, sacraments, parish and churchyard; "Ecclesiastical courts" and "Ecclesiastical hierarchy" are REGISTERED at the 'healing' both spellings already measured to, so the quarantine shrinks 649 -> 647 and no service changes bucket; and exactly three role labels move, each checked to classify IDENTICALLY before and after so faction, category, power band and importance are unmoved and npcGenerator.js, at its 1345 ceiling, is untouched. "Archbishop/Patriarch" is deliberately LEFT, because 'bishop' is a faction keyword and a power band and 'patriarch' an importance pillar: renaming it is a mechanics change, not a display one. WITH D1b THE TOTAL AGAINST fe021a487 IS 525 OF 525 - the twelve riverside villages that held still through D1-D3 carry a parish church, so nothing is left unmoved, and the key set is still identical. D4b, the authored per-culture phrase map that replaces D4's mechanical term-lift, moves ZERO rows for the same reason D4 does. D2 ALONE MOVES 51 OF 525 (thorp 12, hamlet 12, town 1, metropolis 26) over 48 templates, all of them NPC and faction seating. The defect was that POWER_ROLES_BY_CATEGORY files roughly a third of the catalog under its generalist 'other' bucket, getUpgradeOpportunities stamps that BUCKET key onto every row it emits, and mergeNPCLists' CATEGORY_COMPAT reads 'other' as null - which there means "any faction at all" - so the one role table that says least about its holders was the one the compatibility gate stopped reading, and a steppe village printed it: "Khurelbaatar Mangghud - Kheshig - Mercenary-for-Hire - Religious Authorities". The cure reads the ROLE when the bucket declines to classify, inside the existing draw: the single capacity-weighted _rng() roll keeps its count and its position in every arm, and the existing relax cascade still catches a pool the filter empties. THE ROSTER CONTROL, which is the load-bearing half: of the 51 rows, 39 carry an IDENTICAL people-bag - the same names and the same roles, merely re-seated - and 12 (all metropolis) GAIN exactly two faction-structural placeholders ("The Kingpin", "The Lieutenant", generatedAs: 'faction_structural') and LOSE NOTHING. That synthesis is factionRoles.ensureFactionStructuralNpcs, which draws NO rng: before the cure a generalist NPC mis-filed into the criminal faction was covering the Kingpin office and suppressing the seat, and after it the office is honestly unled and the standing placeholder appears. No NPC is lost anywhere and no new rng-drawn person appears. It is NOT a shape change: settlement.npcs is already heterogeneous and that placeholder shape already ships to every settlement holding an uncovered office, which is why check:observed-shape-readers passes at 1966 findings EXACTLY MATCHING THE FROZEN INVENTORY. D3 ALONE MOVES 513 OF 525 over exactly ONE PATH TEMPLATE, $.economicViability.plotHooks[].hook, 842 changes and 9 distinct substitutions, every one a rewritten hook; zero structural movement. D4 MOVES ZERO ROWS OF EITHER SURFACE: composeSettlementQuickGuide is a display read-model (SummaryTabV2, TableView, SessionMode, pdf/sections/TonightAtTheTable) and is never persisted into the settlement, so no fixture that hashes a settlement can see it. THE COMBINED TIP AT D1-D4 MOVED 513 OF 525 over 55 templates, which is 10 (D1) union 48 (D2) union 1 (D3) with four shared, and the set arithmetic closes exactly: UNION(D1,D2,D3) == TIP, with 0 rows in the union that are not in the tip and 0 rows in the tip that no single defect explains. The key set is identical at every arm. The 12 rows that never move are one coherent class - village|<every culture>|riverside|river|civilized - the control that proves the corpus was capable of holding still. SURFACE 1, generator-golden-master: the suite's own drift list prints 513 keys, by tier thorp 84 / hamlet 84 / village 72 / town 105 / city 84 / metropolis 84, reproducing the census to the digit; 525 keys in, 525 keys out. SURFACE 2, espionage-dormancy-fence: its 360-settlement driven corpus moves f13df68e5e511cd385473e95307240d5b73659e11f718eaeafc5f69bf060a69e -> 4f7647372030f1877c12cf80fc4cce1c8828e253c7ae32e6c2283f7c0716592e. WHAT DID NOT MOVE, measured rather than assumed: dossier-prose-manifest, espionage-mission-dormancy-fence, espionage-rider-dormancy-fence, pdf-golden-view-model-snapshot, the npc-growth / npc-ladder / npc-ledger / npc-credibility dormancy goldens, the base-state capsule and the golden-freeze walker are all GREEN at the tip, and so are the lighting census, the institution walkers, the prose-numerics baseline and the mutation-coverage manifest.
